title: SAVOURY BREAD
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Add all the ingredients to the metal bowl and run PASTRY/CAKE. Bring the mixture to the center of the bowl and run PASTRY/CAKE, 10 seconds, to get a uniform mixture. Pour the batter into a greased and floured bread tin and bake for 45 minutes.

title: Buffalo Chicken Tacos
ingredients: avocado oil *Or other high-heat cooking oil for frying.
more buffalo sauce or hot sauce for drizzling inside tacos
crumbled blue cheese, diced tomatoes, or sliced green onions for garnish
instructions: Combine shredded chicken, buffalo sauce, ranch dressing, and cream cheese in a large mixing bowl. Mix until all ingredients are well incorporated. Set aside. Heat griddle to about 400-425°F. Add about 2 tablespoons of avocado oil to the heated surface and spread it around with your spatula. Assemble the tacos on the griddle. Place about 6-8 corn tortillas on the oiled griddle. Top each tortilla with about 3-4 tablespoons of shredded mozzarella cheese. Spread about 3-4 tablespoons of the buffalo chicken mixture on one side of each of the tortillas. Add a few dashes of hot sauce or buffalo sauce on top of the buffalo chicken mixture for a little extra heat (optional). Allow the tacos to cook flat on the griddle for about 2-3 minutes. Use your spatula to fold each corn tortilla in half to form a taco. Cook on the first side for about 2-3 minutes. The, flip to the second side and cook another 2-3 minutes. Continue to cook the tacos, flipping back and forth, until golden and crispy. *If needed, add more avocado oil to the griddle surface and flip the tacos into fresh oil to help the frying process. When tacos are done cooking, transfer to a wire cooling rack to cool for about 5-10 minutes. Then serve with your choice of garnish and/or dipping sauce.

title: Jacket Potatoes with Cheese, Sour Cream, Scallions, and Crispy Bacon
ingredients: 12 baking potatoes, scrubbed and patted dry
1 tablespoon (15 g) unsalted butter, at room temperature
2 teaspoons chopped fresh parsley, for garnish
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C/Gas Mark 6). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Prick the potatoes all over with a fork. Rub them with the oil and place them on the lined baking sheet. Bake until they are fork-tender, about 55 minutes. Remove from the oven and let them cool for 15 minutes. (Leave the oven on.) Meanwhile, in a frying pan, cook the bacon over medium-high heat until crispy, 7-8 minutes. Drain on a paper towel. Halve the potatoes lengthwise. Scoop the potato flesh out with a spoon into a bowl, leaving enough flesh in place to create a sturdy shell ("jacket"). Place the scooped potato shells in a baking dish. Mash the potatoes, the stir in the butter, half of the bacon, half of the cheddar, 1 1/2 cups (145 g) of the sour cream, and the scallion (spring onion). Season to taste with salt and mix well. Fill the potatoes with the mixture and top with the remaing cheddar. Return to the oven and bake until the cheese is golden brown, about 12 minutes. Transfer the potatoes to a serving plate, top with the remaing bacon, and garnish with the parsley. Top with the remaing 1/2 cup (50 g) sour cream. Note: If you would like to make a homemade sour cream, pour 1/3 cup (25 fl oz/75 ml) whole milk into a bowl. Add 1 tablespoons fresh lemon juice and stir carefully. Let it rest for 15 minutes, then stir in 1 1/4 cups (10 fl oz/300 ml) cream. Cover with a towel and let it rest at room temperature for at least 24 hours.

title: Strawberry crumble squares
ingredients: 180g/6oz/1/2 cup butter, margarine or low-fat baking spread, chilled
instructions: Prehaet the oven to 180°C/350°F/Gas 4. Grease a 35 x 25cm/14 x 10in deep baking tin (pan), then line it with baking paper. Sift the flour and baking powder into a bowl and stir in the sugar. Cut the butter into cubes and rub into the flour mixture with your fingertips until it resembles fine breadcrumbs. Beat the egg and mix into the crumbs which should come into larger clumps. Reserve a quater of the crumbs for the topping and press the rest firmly into base of the lined tin in an even layer with your fingertips. For the strawberry layer, in a mixing bowl, whisk together the cream cheese, half of the caster sugar and the eggs until you have a smooth mixture. Hull and halve the strawberries. Place in a bowl and sift over the cornflour and the remaing caster sugar and leave for a few minutes. Stir the fruit to ensure that it is all coated in the cornflour and the sugar. Sprinkle the strawberries over the shortcake base and spoon over the cream cheese mixture. Mix lightly together. Sprinkle over the remaing crumb mixture and the pine nuts. Bake in the preheat oven for 35-40 minutes until the top is lightly golden brown then leave to cool completely in the tin before serving. Remove the lining paper and cut into 24 squares to serve. Store any uneaten cakes in the refrigerator for up to 3 days but this is best eaten on the day it is made.

title: BEST BUTTERMILK PANCAKES
ingredients: 4 Tablespoons unsalted butter melted and cooled
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt, until well-combined. In a separate bowl, whisk together buttermilk, eggs, and vanilla.
